limitations: Historical recorded evidence extracted from files, not a fresh rerun.
Normal-page direct-stack timing excludes MV3/offscreen setup, actual X contention and current switching/download paths.
Original native packages and unnumbered prompts differ from the current text-only QAT contract; do not combine old timing with later quality.
Native timing includes the development proxy; no estimated transport overhead is subtracted.
Whole-Chrome absolute memory includes substantial unrelated baseline memory; paired increments are estimates, not isolated tab memory.
Footprint, RSS, installed bytes and GPU allocation are distinct; do not add them or infer battery/energy savings.
Discovery corpora are small synthetic diagnostics and do not establish universal quality or replacement qualification.
Validation sections import pre-existing Gemma baseline decisions only; their source hashes and exact case identities are pinned, and they are not new decision-model validation measurements.
caseIdentityEncoding: sha256(JSON.stringify({id,text,filters,expected})); UTF-8; fixed property order; ordered filters and Boolean labels; no normalization
